# Crowd Control sub-actions

## Get session

Checks the current Crowd Control play session and saves the answer in variables. Handy to show what game is running.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%ccConnected%` | True if Cuebot is connected to Crowd Control |
| `%ccSessionActive%` | True if a play session is running |
| `%ccSessionPaused%` | True if it is paused |
| `%ccGameName%` | The game being played |
| `%ccGamePackName%` | The game pack being used |
| `%ccTimedEffectCount%` | How many lasting effects are running |
| `%ccTimedEffects%` | The names of those effects, joined with commas |
| `%ccGameSessionId%` | The number of this session |
| `%ccSessionStarted%` | When it started |

<small>Type id: `crowdcontrol.getSession`</small>

## Send test event

Makes a pretend Crowd Control event so you can try your actions without a real viewer.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Event** | Which pretend event to make, like effectSuccess for a working effect or coinExchange for coins added. Options: effectRequest, effectSuccess, effectFailure, effectRefund, timedEffectStarted, timedEffectUpdated, timedEffectEnded, coinExchange, gameSessionStart, gameSessionEnd. Starts as: `effectSuccess`. |

<small>Type id: `crowdcontrol.sendTestEvent`</small>
